title: Vali's Last Gift: the Golden Garland

claims.claim: Rama said: "Lakshmana, uproot this flowering gajapushpi creeper and put it around Sugriva's neck." Lakshmana did.
Now notice this. Vali already wore a garland. A golden one, given by his father, Indra.
But his life did not leave at once. Valmiki says the golden garland Indra gave him held on to his life, his strength and his splendour.
"Sugriva, fate never meant us to be happy together. This kingdom is yours now."
"Look at Angada, lying on the ground, full of tears. Now you must protect him."
"And Tara's judgement is never wrong. Whatever she says, do it."
"And Sugriva, wear this divine golden garland. Its splendour would leave it when I die."
That same golden garland. Indra's gift. The one that had held Vali's life until now. Now around Sugriva's neck.
And Sugriva's joy turned to grief, like the moon in an eclipse.
"Angada, bear both joy and sorrow. Stay obedient to Sugriva."
And saying this, Vali gave up his life.

score.prompt: Vali's last moments: a hush of grief under the recited verse, the dying king's dignity, a slow rising theme as he gives his son and his brother their last advice, the soaring strings peak when he takes off Indra's golden garland and gives it to Sugriva, then a noble, quiet resolution.

caption: Vali wore a golden garland, a gift from his father Indra; Valmiki says it held his life, strength and splendour even after the arrow struck (Valmiki Ramayana 4.17.5). As he died, Vali told Sugriva: wear this divine golden garland (4.22.16). The brother he had driven out took it, and his joy turned to grief (4.22.17). Full 14-min video on our YouTube.

shots.en: Rama said: "Lakshmana, uproot this flowering gajapushpi creeper and put it around Sugriva's neck." Lakshmana did.

shots.en: Now notice this. Vali already wore a garland. A golden one, given by his father, Indra.

shots.hi: इस सोने की माला को, याद रखिएगा। कहानी के अंत में, ये फिर लौटेगी।
shots.en: Remember that golden garland. It comes back at the end of the story.

shots.hi: पर प्राण, तुरंत नहीं गए। वाल्मीकि कहते हैं: इंद्र की दी हुई सोने की माला ने, उनके प्राण, तेज और शोभा को, थामे रखा।
shots.en: But his life did not leave at once. Valmiki says the golden garland Indra gave him held on to his life, his strength and his splendour.
